tagline: Devin + n8n + Temporal, em um binário. Self-hosted, intention-DSL agentic workflow platform.
status: phase-7 complete — Alpine NoCloud boot + silent QEMU + reset cmd. Binary ~450MB.

philosophy.build_command: mage build  (NEVER go build directly — embedded assets must be populated first)
philosophy.zero_cognitive_effort: init runs fully automated; config wizard reuses existing values

binary_composition.description: Binary embeds QEMU + ready-to-boot Alpine cloud qcow2 via go:embed. Init extracts to .golovebox/, runs cloud-init on first VM boot, and is online via SSH.
binary_composition.embed_strategy: build tags per OS select QEMU asset dir (windows/linux/darwin); Alpine cloud image is shared across OSes

assets.qemu_windows: ~80MB — extracted from weilnetz.de NSIS installer (silent /S install, no UAC)

targets.mage fetch: downloads all assets for current host OS
targets.mage fetchWindows: QEMU Windows via silent NSIS install (no admin, no UAC)
targets.mage check: verify embedded assets present and sized correctly
targets.mage clean: remove downloaded assets and build/ scratch dirs

build_system.dev_setup: go install github.com/magefile/mage@latest && mage fetch && mage build

vm_setup.approach: Alpine NoCloud cloud image (qcow2) + CIDATA seed — boot direct, no install step
vm_setup.previous_approach_phase5_6: Alpine Virt ISO + cloud-init — never worked, Virt ISO is interactive installer with no cloud-init on boot path
flow: extract embedded Alpine cloud qcow2 → .golovebox/vm/base.img (idempotency: .alpine-image-size marker)
build CIDATA ISO9660 with user-data (SSH key + sshd drop-in for PermitRootLogin)
boot: base.img (virtio-blk-pci bootindex=0) + cidata.iso (virtio-blk-pci, no bootindex)
cloud-init runs ~1m42s on first boot: applies key, drops /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-golovebox.conf, restarts sshd
host polls SSH on localhost:2222 for up to 5 min until echo ok
vm_setup.qemu_silent_boot: stdout/stderr/stdin redirected: stdout→vm/qemu.log, stdin→os.DevNull. Terminal never invaded.
vm_setup.qcow2_magic_check: sandbox.Start() reads first 4 bytes of base.img; aborts with clear error if magic != QFI\xfb

intention_dsl.description: Plain-language Markdown with optional uppercase keywords. Parsed in internal/dsl/.

keywords.ATTENTION_HERE: pauses graph, awaits human review in web chat (orange node)
keywords.NOT_TODO: logged to tech_debt.md, excluded from DAG
keywords.RUN_TEST: gate node — DAG only advances if tests pass

skills.format: TOML frontmatter (name, description, tools, examples) + freeform prompt body
skills.generated: golovebox skill generate "<description>" — LLM produces skill template
skills.auto_included: orchestrator injects skill list into planning context

web_ui.embedded: HTML+JS served from binary via embed.FS (no Electron, no React build step)
web_ui.sse_stream: /api/runs/{id}/stream — server-sent events for live canvas updates

stack.llm: internal/llm — pure HTTP wrapper, OpenAI-compatible + Anthropic Messages, retry with exponential backoff (2s base, 30s cap, 3 attempts)
stack.qemu_control: internal/sandbox/qmp.go — direct QMP TCP client (no go-qemu dep)

commands.init: golovebox init [--repair] — config wizard (reuses existing config.toml, asks Y/n) + extract + boot + cloud-init
commands.reset: golovebox reset [--hard] [-y] — soft: delete base.img+cidata; hard: delete entire .golovebox/. Confirmation required (y/N soft, 'yes' literal hard).
commands.web: golovebox web [--addr :8080] [--timeout 30] — boot VM, start web server, open browser
commands.run: golovebox run <spec-dir-or-file> — parse specs, plan DAG via LLM, execute with terminal progress
commands.resume: golovebox resume <run-id> — reset running nodes to pending, re-execute from current state
commands.status: golovebox status [run-id] — VM/config status, or DAG status for a specific run
commands.exec: golovebox exec "<cmd>" — shell command in VM via SSH
commands.github: golovebox github --repo o/r --issue N — resolve a GitHub issue (one-shot)

steps: 2. config wizard (reuses existing values via [bracketed defaults])
7. boot VM (cloud-init ~1m42s) + SSH smoke test (poll up to 5 min)
first_boot.requires_internet: only mage fetch at build time; init itself is fully offline

runtime_layout..golovebox/vm/base.img: Alpine cloud qcow2 (~164MB initial, may grow)
runtime_layout..golovebox/vm/.alpine-image-size: idempotency marker — size of embedded qcow2
runtime_layout..golovebox/vm/qemu.log: QEMU stdout/stderr (serial console of running VM)
runtime_layout..golovebox/runs/<run-id>/: dag.json + node_states.json + specs/ + logs/ + artifacts/ + run_summary.md

agent_loop.flow: prompt → LLM → parse action → execute tool → observe → repeat

llm_providers.ollama: http://localhost:11434 — local models, no API key

project_structure.cmd/golovebox/main.go: CLI entrypoint, all cobra commands (init, reset, web, run, resume, status, exec, github, daemon, skill)
project_structure.magefile.go: build pipeline (fetch, build, check, clean) — //go:build mage
project_structure.internal/config/config.go: portable paths (relative to executable), TOML load/save
project_structure.internal/embed/extract.go: ExtractQEMU, ExtractAlpineImage (writes base.img with qcow2 magic check)
project_structure.internal/embed/cloudinit.go: CIDATA ISO9660 builder; user-data with sshd drop-in
project_structure.internal/sandbox/: qemu.go (Start/Stop, qcow2 validation, silent boot, QMP retry), qmp.go, ssh.go, pool.go
project_structure.internal/web/: HTTP server, SSE broker, embedded UI (HTML+JS)

v0_done_definition: Drop 10 spec .md files into golovebox web, watch orchestrator generate a DAG, sub-agents build the app inside isolated Alpine VM, checkpoints pause for review in web chat, result is tested code + PR opened + notification sent — all from a single .exe with zero install.
out_of_scope_v0: parallel multi-agent (one agent per repo at a time)
fully offline first boot (mage fetch needs internet)

known_limitations.binary_size: ~450MB (was ~300MB before Phase 7; cloud qcow2 is bigger than ISO but eliminates 10-min install step)
known_limitations.tcg_no_kvm_windows: first cloud-init boot takes ~1m42s on Windows (TCG software emulation); ~10s on Linux with KVM
known_limitations.alpine_version_hardcoded: magefile.go points to 3.21.7-r0; update manually for new releases
known_limitations.cloud_init_second_boot: cidata changes after first boot are NOT reapplied — use 'golovebox reset' to force
known_limitations.x86_64_bios_only: ARM and UEFI variants would need different qemu args + firmware

risks_addressed: QEMU portable mode without admin → solved by weilnetz.de silent NSIS install with __COMPAT_LAYER=RunAsInvoker
Terminal hijacked by QEMU serial → solved by stdout/stderr→log file, stdin→DevNull
Alpine Virt ISO interactive installer → solved by switching to Alpine NoCloud cloud qcow2
Stale base.img across upgrades → solved by .alpine-image-size marker + qcow2 magic check
Lost config.toml on init failure → solved by moving config wizard to step 2 (before any heavy work)
